payload.description: Why the 2024/25 audit opinion was disclaimed. The certificate says only that Ernst & Young could not give an opinion and that the audit was later closed once the National Audit Office confirmed it needed nothing further. It gives no reason. A disclaimed opinion has been common across English councils since the government set deadlines to clear a national audit backlog, and that context matters to reading this one — but no council document in this archive says so, so this page does not say it either. What we looked for: an explanation in the council's own published audit papers. What is not banked here: the Annual Governance Statements, and any national guidance on the audit backlog.
